name: portal-api-finder
description: Finds the internal API calls behind a portal workflow from a browser-exported HAR file.

scripts.dev: npm run build:web && tsx watch src/server.ts
scripts.build:web: esbuild web/main.tsx --bundle --minify --sourcemap --outfile=public/app.js --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\" && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['index.html','styles.css'])fs.copyFileSync('web/'+f,'public/'+f)"
